description: This file contains utility functions for type coercion, metamethod handling, and bitwise operations in Lua. It defines internal functions for converting values to integers, calls metamethods, and sets up metatables with custom bitwise operation implementations.

methods.name: toint
methods.description: Converts a value to an integer if possible, returning false otherwise.

methods.name: trymt
methods.description: Attempts to call a metamethod for a value if the second operand is not a string.

methods.name: checkargs
methods.description: Checks and converts two arguments to integers, or attempts to call metamethods if conversion fails.
